title: Shoulders
style: Folk-rock, high light upper-register vocals opening into powerful full-voice belts, layered through the chorus; tape-saturated production; strummed acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass and live drums, with bright synths and a pulsing four-on-the-floor beat in instrumental eurodance bridges; steady midtempo rock groove.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Young Sylvia pulls him through the door
Her teal hair in his sight
She wraps his arm against her chest
And holds on through the night

At Casa del Tresor she works
With confidence and care
He wonders what a father feels
And finds a comfort there

[Pre-chorus]
She claims his shoulder as her own
The one sure thing she's always known

[Chorus]
They don't want his money, don't want his name
They come for the anchor, they come for the frame
The arms and the shoulders that hold them upright
When the world goes dark and they can't see the light
He's the steady ground when the walls give way
The shoulder that stays at the end of the day

[Verse 2]
Gabi's apartment in Sant Martí
Is finally her own
A place to call hers, a room to breathe
A life she's finally grown

She texts him laughing, eggplant signs
Then asks him, "Xumi too?"
He sees the pattern taking shape
Of what they all come to

[Pre-chorus]
They don't want the man, they want the stead
The quiet strength that stands instead

[Chorus]
They don't want his money, don't want his name
They come for the anchor, they come for the frame
The arms and the shoulders that hold them upright
When the world goes dark and they can't see the light
He's the steady ground when the walls give way
The shoulder that stays at the end of the day

[Bridge (about Xumi)]
Xumi asks if his shoulder will still be there
When the thing with Pere falls through
He holds the question, holds the weight
Of being the one they come to
He is not the partner, not the chosen one
Just the shoulder when the day is done

[Outro (Erika)]
Erika sobs with her head on his arm
"Tyst," she says, "if I needed words, I wouldn't be here"
She sits on his lap and looks in his eyes
"You're my friend and my fuckboy, and that's why I'm here"
He grabs his keys, "Get your passport and clothes
We're catching the train before the night closes"
He is the shoulder, he is the frame
He is the anchor, not the name
